name: Colemak-Viet
description: Colemak, with the DH mod, retuned for the Telex keystream of Vietnamese.
comment: Source of truth for every generated file in dist/. Each row lists the letters
in physical key order, left to right, on an ANSI board. The left half of the
bottom row sits on the angle-mod positions (QWERTY Z X C V B), exactly as in
QWERTY, for reference:  qwertyuiop / asdfghjkl; / zxcvbnm,./
shortcut_note: Letters that must stay on the left half so Cmd+C/V/S/T/R/A/Z still work
one-handed. `x` (Cmd+X, cut) left this list in 1.1.0: it moved to the
top-right corner so the B key could hand Cmd+Z back to the left hand.
